mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, salt, password_hash, points, total_spins, day_key, day_count, version, created_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{salt}, #{passwordHash}, #{points}, #{totalSpins}, #{dayKey}, #{dayCount}, #{version}, #{createdAt})
